summary: [standards] Mutation probe of every seeded case (my own uncommitted test, deleted): with each case's own condition switched off (check_binary_mutated), the owner stops failing for all but four conditions of L1.walk: walk/rule-5, walk/rule-3-domain-compile, walk/group-path, walk/kind keep failing L1.walk because their seeded documents also break walk/valid, so those four conditions are not independently proven (removing one leaves its case red). With a case planted, no check other than its owner changes result except tree/answered (a missing schema makes every schema-dependent check unsupported, which the level then fails through L1.tree). Test 28 switches off and forces to pass only the first case of each check, and ends `let _ = unjudged;` so 'the set of conditions a conforming run judges is the set the cases plant' holds one way only. Blast radius: L1.walk.
